items.title: Exploring equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy: A meta-epidemiological study.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological study of 94 telehealth randomized controlled trials in physiotherapy found that most research focuses on effectiveness rather than explicitly addressing health equity using the PROGRESS-Plus framework.
items.curatedReason: PT 远程医疗研究关注点仍集中在有效性，而对健康公平性的考虑不足。在设计和实施远程医疗服务时，需要更主动地将 PROGRESS-Plus 框架整合进来，确保其能触达更广泛、更多元的患者群体。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗远程医疗干预中的公平性探索：一项荟萃流行病学研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 94 项物理治疗远程医疗随机对照试验的荟萃流行病学研究发现，大多数研究侧重于有效性，而不是明确使用 PROGRESS-Plus 框架解决健康公平性问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: PT telehealth research still focuses primarily on effectiveness, with insufficient consideration for health equity. When designing and implementing telehealth services, you need to proactively integrate the PROGRESS-Plus framework to ensure they reach a broader, more diverse patient population.
items.limitation: 本研究的观察性设计限制了对 telehealth 干预与健康公平性之间因果关系的推断。
items.limitationEn: The observational design of this study limits causal inferences between telehealth interventions and health equity.

items.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=45) found that adding tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy in Parkinson's disease resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months compared to device-aided therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 为帕金森病患者在设备辅助治疗启动后加用量身定制的基层康复提供了坚实的证据，它能更好地维持患者的运动技能。这意味着你在为帕金森患者制定康复计划时，应积极考虑在早期将个性化康复干预与设备辅助治疗相结合。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者设备辅助治疗启动后康复结局：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=45）发现，在帕金森病设备辅助治疗基础上增加量身定制的基层康复，能更好地维持患者在 6 个月和 12 个月时的运动技能，优于仅设备辅助治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides robust evidence that tailored primary care rehabilitation, when added after device-aided therapy initiation in Parkinson's disease, better maintains patient motor skills. This means you should actively consider integrating personalized rehabilitation interventions with device-aided therapy early when planning rehabilitation for Parkinson's patients.
items.limitation: 样本量相对较小（45/54 名患者完成），可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small sample size (45/54 patients completed) may limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Pregnancy-Related Musculoskeletal Pain: Current Management, Influence on Biopsychosocial Health, and Patient-Reported Satisfaction With Care.
items.summary: An international internet survey of 671 women found that while musculoskeletal pain is common during pregnancy, less than 1 in 5 respondents reported being referred to physical therapy, highlighting a gap in care.
items.curatedReason: 这次国际调查显示，尽管孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛很常见，但转诊到物理治疗的比例仍然很低，只有不到 1/5 的患者获得了转诊。这提示你在诊所中应更积极地筛查孕期 MSK 疼痛，并主动推广物理治疗的价值。
items.titleZh: 孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛：现有管理、对生物心理社会健康的影响以及患者对护理的满意度
items.summaryZh: 一项对 671 名女性进行的国际在线调查显示，孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛很常见，但只有不到 1/5 的受访者表示曾被转诊至物理治疗，这突显了护理方面的缺口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This international survey indicates that despite the high prevalence of pregnancy-related musculoskeletal pain, physical therapy referral rates remain low, with less than one-fifth of patients receiving referrals. This suggests you should more proactively screen for MSK pain during pregnancy and actively promote the value of physical therapy.
items.limitation: 研究采用互联网调查设计，可能存在选择偏倚和回忆偏倚，且无法评估因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study utilized an internet survey design, which may introduce selection and recall bias, and causality cannot be assessed.

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: This case report describes the rehabilitation and accelerated return to competition for a 22-year-old elite sprinter who sustained a full-thickness lateral abdominal wall tear, emphasizing data-informed decision-making.
items.curatedReason: 对于罕见的腹壁全层撕裂，这份单病例报告提示，即便是精英运动员，通过严密监控数据也能实现加速康复和重返赛场。在处理类似损伤时，请务必关注具体的功能指标和表现数据，不要被动等待。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场：一项数据驱动的病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 22 岁精英短跑运动员腹壁外侧全层撕裂后的康复和加速重返赛场过程，强调了数据驱动的决策。
items.curatedReasonEn: For rare full-thickness abdominal wall tears, this single case suggests that even elite athletes can achieve accelerated rehab and return to sport with rigorous data-informed monitoring. When managing similar injuries, focus on specific functional metrics and performance data; do not passively wait.
items.limitation: 作为单病例报告，其发现的普适性非常有限，不能直接推断到其他患者。
items.limitationEn: As a single case report, the generalizability of its findings is very limited and cannot be directly extrapolated to other patients.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Preliminary effects of myofascial release on chest mobility and trunk impairmentin patients with chronic stroke: a pilotRandomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot RCT with 20 chronic stroke patients found that myofascial release combined with inspiratory muscle training might improve chest mobility and trunk impairment compared to stretching and diaphragmatic breathing.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项小样本先导研究，提示筋膜松动术结合吸气肌训练可能改善慢性卒中患者的胸廓活动度。结果有趣但非定论，别急着作为常规方案，可考虑作为观察性辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 筋膜松动术对慢性卒中患者胸廓活动度和躯干功能障碍的初步影响：一项先导随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 20 名慢性卒中患者的先导随机对照试验发现，筋膜松动术结合吸气肌训练可能改善患者的胸廓活动度和躯干功能障碍，优于拉伸和膈肌呼吸。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests myofascial release combined with inspiratory muscle training might improve chest mobility in chronic stroke patients. The findings are interesting but not definitive. Do not rush to integrate this as a standard protocol; consider it an observational adjunct.
items.limitation: 这是一项样本量极小的先导研究 (n=20)，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a very small pilot study (n=20), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Telerehabilitation before and after lumbar spine surgery: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped existing evidence on telerehabilitation interventions for patients undergoing lumbar spine surgery, finding a lack of standardized protocols, despite established effectiveness in general low back pain and joint replacement.
items.curatedReason: 对于腰椎术前术后康复，远程医疗的证据基础尚不成熟。尽管既往在 LBP 和关节置换领域有效，但该综述指出，腰椎术后远程康复的干预措施、方案和技术仍缺乏标准化。
items.titleZh: 腰椎手术前后的远程康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述梳理了腰椎手术患者的远程康复干预现有证据，发现尽管在腰痛和关节置换中远程康复已显示出疗效，但腰椎术后缺乏标准化方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: The evidence base for telerehabilitation in pre- and post-lumbar spine surgery is still nascent. While effective for LBP and joint replacement, this review highlights a lack of standardized interventions, protocols, and technologies for post-lumbar spine surgery telerehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，侧重于映射现有证据而非评估证据质量，因此无法就干预效果给出强有力的结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review focused on mapping existing evidence rather than assessing its quality, thus strong conclusions on intervention efficacy cannot be drawn.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Managing Patients With Hypermobility Disorders: They've Seen You, but Have You Seen Them?
items.summary: This editorial provides guidance for physical therapists on managing patients with hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS), highlighting the need for better care despite limited high-quality randomized trials.
items.curatedReason: 处理关节过度活动综合征（HSD）和 Ehler-Danlos 综合征（hEDS）患者的挑战在于缺乏高质量 RCT。这份社论基于当前共识，为你管理这类复杂患者提供了初步方向，避免碎片化或无效的治疗策略。
items.titleZh: 管理关节过度活动障碍患者：他们见过你，你了解他们吗？
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论为物理治疗师管理关节过度活动综合征（HSD）和过度活动型 Ehler-Danlos 综合征（hEDS）患者提供了指导，强调尽管高质量随机试验有限，但仍需改善对这类患者的护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: Managing patients with hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS) is challenging due to limited high-quality RCTs. This editorial, though a consensus-based guide, offers essential initial direction for these complex cases, helping you avoid fragmented or ineffective treatment approaches.
items.limitation: 这是一篇社论，主要基于专家共识和有限证据，而非系统综述或 RCT。
items.limitationEn: This is an editorial, primarily based on expert consensus and limited evidence, not a systematic review or RCT.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.
items.summary: The sixth part of the "Moving Forward Together" series is an editorial urging musculoskeletal physical therapists, organizations, and systems to improve care and outcomes for Indigenous Peoples by integrating Indigenous health into their work.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论呼吁物理治疗师在临床、研究和教育中关注原住民的肌肉骨骼健康。它更多是行动倡议而非临床指南，提醒你关注多元文化和公平实践。
items.titleZh: 共同前进。第六部分：为原住民群体改善肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗——行动呼吁。
items.summaryZh: “共同前进”系列的第六部分是一篇社论，敦促肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统通过将原住民健康融入其工作，以改善原住民的护理和治疗结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial calls on physical therapists to prioritize Indigenous musculoskeletal health in clinical practice, research, and education. It serves more as a call to action than a clinical guideline, reminding you to consider multicultural and equitable practices.
items.limitation: 这是一篇社论，提出了行动倡议而非临床研究发现。
items.limitationEn: This is an editorial, presenting a call to action rather than clinical research findings.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Eccentric cycling for ACL-R rehabilitation: A masterclass.
items.summary: Eccentric cycling is an established method for strength development in ACL reconstruction (ACL-R) rehabilitation, with evidence suggesting early progressive implementation from three weeks post-operation may benefit quadriceps atrophy, strength deficits, and return-to-sport performance.
items.curatedReason: 偏心骑行是 ACL 重建康复的有效策略。这份综述表明，在术后约三周开始早期渐进式偏心训练，有望改善股四头肌萎缩和力量不足，还能提高重返运动表现。你可以在实践中考虑更早地引入个体化的偏心训练。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建康复中的偏心骑行：大师课。
items.summaryZh: 偏心骑行是前交叉韧带重建（ACL-R）康复中建立力量的既定方法，有证据表明，术后约三周开始早期渐进式实施，可能有利于改善股四头肌萎缩、力量不足和重返运动表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Eccentric cycling is an effective strategy for ACL-R rehabilitation. This review suggests that early progressive eccentric training, starting around three weeks post-operation, can potentially improve quadriceps atrophy and strength deficits, and enhance return-to-sport performance. Consider introducing individualized eccentric training earlier in your practice.
items.limitation: 该文章为综述性质，未提供具体研究的样本量和效应量数据。
items.limitationEn: This article is a masterclass review and does not provide specific sample sizes or effect sizes from individual studies.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Neurocognitive training with visual perturbation improves dual-task hop performance in male athletes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that neurocognitive training with visual perturbation improved dual-task hop performance in male athletes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后的男性运动员，加入视觉扰动（例如，通过 VR 或分心任务）的神经认知训练，可以显著改善双任务跳跃表现。将这种训练整合到返场方案中，有助于运动员更好地应对实际运动场景。
items.titleZh: 视觉扰动下的神经认知训练改善 ACL 重建术后男性运动员双任务跳跃表现的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，针对 ACL 重建术后的男性运动员，结合视觉扰动的神经认知训练能提高其双任务跳跃表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: For male athletes post-ACLR, neurocognitive training with visual perturbation (e.g., via VR or distraction tasks) significantly improves dual-task hop performance. Integrate this type of training into return-to-sport protocols to better prepare athletes for real-world athletic demands.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于男性运动员，可能不完全适用于女性或不同年龄组。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to male athletes, which may affect generalizability to females or other age groups.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of Combined Aerobic and Resistance Training on Exercise Capacity, Muscle Strength, Quality of Life, and Mortality in Patients with Coronary Heart Disease: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that combined aerobic and resistance training improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and mortality in patients with coronary heart disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和 Meta 分析强化了联合有氧和阻力训练对冠心病患者运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率的益处。继续将这两种训练模式作为心肺康复的核心。
items.titleZh: 联合有氧和阻力训练对冠心病患者运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率的影响：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与 Meta 分析发现，联合有氧和阻力训练能改善冠心病患者的运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that combined aerobic and resistance training significantly improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and reduces mortality in coronary heart disease patients. It's wise to make these two training modalities core interventions in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但其结果的异质性可能受纳入研究质量和干预方案差异的影响。
items.limitationEn: Despite being a systematic review, result heterogeneity might be influenced by the quality of included studies and variations in intervention protocols.

items.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 2
items.summary: CMS's proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule includes changes to the Quality Payment Program, potentially ending the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) in 2029.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 提议在 2029 年结束 MIPS，并改变 Medicare 医生收费标准中的实践费用计算方法。如果你是美国 PT，需密切关注这些变化，因为它们可能影响你的报销金额和质量报告要求。
items.titleZh: 拟议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准：PTs 需要了解的，第二部分
items.summaryZh: CMS 拟议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准包括质量支付计划的调整，可能在 2029 年结束“基于绩效的激励支付系统（MIPS）”。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS in the US proposes ending MIPS in 2029 and changing how practice expenses are calculated in the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule. If you are a US PT, monitor these changes closely as they may affect your reimbursement and quality reporting requirements.

items.title: Advocates, Leaders Drive Payment Momentum During APTA Payment Advocacy Summit
items.summary: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit brought together advocates and leaders to advance physical therapy payment policies for practice sustainability and patient access to care, building on recent state payment successes.
items.curatedReason: APTA 支付倡导峰会强调了其在改善物理治疗支付政策方面的努力。这让你了解美国 PT 行业在推动可持续执业和患者可及性方面的最新进展。
items.titleZh: APTA 支付倡导峰会期间，倡导者和领导者推动支付势头
items.summaryZh: APTA 支付倡导峰会汇聚倡导者和领导者，以推动物理治疗支付政策，支持执业可持续性和患者护理可及性，并在近期各州支付成功的基础上更进一步。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit showcased efforts to improve physical therapy payment policies. Understanding these advancements can help you better grasp industry trends and contribute to practice sustainability and patient access.

items.title: Prior Authorization for Certain Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) Services
items.summary: CMS has established a nationwide prior authorization process for certain hospital outpatient department (OPD) services to control unnecessary volume and ensure medically necessary care for Medicare beneficiaries.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 继续推行某些医院门诊服务（OPD）的预先授权程序。如果你在医院门诊部门执业，必须熟悉这些要求，以确保符合 Medicare 规定并避免报销问题。
items.titleZh: 某些医院门诊部（OPD）服务的预先授权
items.summaryZh: CMS 已为某些医院门诊部服务设立了全国性的预先授权程序，以控制不必要的服务量，并确保 Medicare 受益人获得医学上必需的护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS in the US continues to implement prior authorization for certain Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) services. If you practice in an OPD setting, you must be familiar with these requirements to ensure Medicare compliance and prevent reimbursement issues.

items.title: Reduced ipsilateral pre-operative forefoot pressure during gait is associated with poorer post-operative postural control in people with chronic ankle instability
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found that reduced ipsilateral pre-operative forefoot pressure during gait is associated with poorer post-operative postural control in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，术前步态中内侧前足压力降低可能预示术后平衡控制能力较差。这提示我们在术前评估时要关注足底压力分布，并可能需要针对性地加强术后平衡训练。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者术前步态中同侧前足压力降低与术后姿势控制能力下降相关
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，慢性踝关节不稳患者术前步态中同侧前足压力降低与术后姿势控制能力下降相关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In individuals with chronic ankle instability, reduced ipsilateral pre-operative forefoot pressure during gait may predict poorer post-operative postural control. This suggests focusing on plantar pressure distribution during pre-operative assessment and potentially intensifying post-operative balance training.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立因果关系，其发现可能仅为关联性而非预后性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality; its findings may indicate association rather than prognosis.

items.title: Association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia in community-dwelling older women: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found an association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia in community-dwelling older women.
items.curatedReason: 在社区居住的老年女性中，步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症存在关联。这提示我们，评估老年女性跌倒和骨折风险时，步态稳定性（如步长变异性）可能是一个与肌少症和骨密度同样重要的指标。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年女性步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，社区居住老年女性的步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In community-dwelling older women, stride length variability is associated with osteosarcopenia. This suggests that when assessing fall and fracture risk in older women, gait stability (e.g., stride length variability) might be as important an indicator as sarcopenia and bone density.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确定步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot determine the causal relationship between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia.

items.title: Instrumented assessment of joint neuromechanics in upper motor neuron syndrome: a systematic review of methods, reliability, validity, and clinical relevance
items.summary: A systematic review explored the instrumented assessment of joint neuromechanics in upper motor neuron syndrome, focusing on methods, reliability, validity, and clinical relevance.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述为上运动神经元综合征患者关节神经力学的器械评估提供了方法学、可靠性、有效性和临床相关性的概述。它能帮助你更好地理解和选择评估神经系统损伤后关节力学的工具，但没有直接的干预建议。
items.titleZh: 上运动神经元综合征关节神经力学器械评估：方法、可靠性、有效性和临床相关性系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述探讨了上运动神经元综合征中关节神经力学器械评估的方法、可靠性、有效性和临床相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review provides an overview of methods, reliability, validity, and clinical relevance for instrumented assessment of joint neuromechanics in upper motor neuron syndrome. It can help you better understand and select tools for evaluating joint mechanics after neurological injury, but offers no direct intervention recommendations.
items.limitation: 该综述侧重于评估方法本身，而非特定干预措施的疗效。
items.limitationEn: This review focuses on assessment methods themselves, rather than the efficacy of specific interventions.

items.title: How PT-PTA Teams Are Expanding Access to Care
items.summary: Physical therapists and physical therapist assistants are enhancing collaboration to improve access, efficiency, and patient outcomes in various care settings.
items.curatedReason: PT-PTA 团队的有效协作是扩大护理可及性、提高效率和改善患者结局的关键。重新审视并优化你所在机构的 PT-PTA 协作模式，是确保高质量服务的重要一步。
items.titleZh: PT-PTA 团队如何扩大护理可及性
items.summaryZh: 物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理正在加强协作，以改善各种护理环境下的服务可及性、效率和患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Effective PT-PTA team collaboration is crucial for expanding care access, improving efficiency, and enhancing patient outcomes. Re-evaluating and optimizing your facility's PT-PTA collaboration model is an important step towards ensuring high-quality services.

items.title: Comment on “swedish massage versus hip strengthening exercises for pain and function in older adults with knee osteoarthritis: a randomized controlled trial”
items.summary: This article provides a comment on a randomized controlled trial comparing Swedish massage versus hip strengthening exercises for pain and function in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这是一篇对关于瑞典式按摩与髋部强化锻炼在老年膝骨关节炎患者中随机对照试验的评论。它为你提供了对现有证据的批判性视角，但本身不提供新的临床干预证据。
items.titleZh: 关于“瑞典式按摩与髋部强化锻炼对老年膝骨关节炎患者疼痛和功能影响的随机对照试验”的评论
items.summaryZh: 本文评论了一项关于瑞典式按摩与髋部强化锻炼对老年膝骨关节炎患者疼痛和功能影响的随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a commentary on an RCT comparing Swedish massage and hip strengthening exercises for older adults with knee osteoarthritis. It offers a critical perspective on existing evidence but doesn't provide new clinical intervention evidence itself.

items.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: External validation of a machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke showed good performance in an independent Danish cohort. Predictions were generated from baseline assessments at 2 weeks post-stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究对卒中后上肢恢复的机器学习预测模型进行了外部验证，结果显示，该模型在不同队列中仍能保持良好的预测性能。这意味着，在卒中早期结合机器学习工具，有助于你更可靠地规划康复方案。
items.titleZh: 早期预测卒中后上肢恢复的机器学习模型的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对卒中后上肢恢复机器学习预测模型的外部验证显示，该模型在独立的丹麦队列中仍能良好预测卒中后 6 个月上肢能力，预测基于卒中后 2 周的基线评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study externally validated a machine learning model for predicting upper-limb recovery after stroke, demonstrating good predictive performance across different cohorts. This suggests that integrating machine learning tools early post-stroke can help you plan rehabilitation more reliably.
items.limitation: 研究使用的模型是基于特定队列开发的，模型在其他更广泛或异质性更强的患者群体中的表现仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed on specific cohorts; its performance in broader or more heterogeneous patient populations still requires further validation.

items.title: Acute Effects of Varying Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation Amplitude on Quadriceps Isometric Torque and Muscle Thickness in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Split-Limb Trial.
items.summary: A randomized split-limb trial on healthy young adults found varying neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) amplitude affects quadriceps isometric torque and muscle thickness. Higher amplitudes enhanced acute neuromuscular responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机肢体交叉试验提示，NMES 刺激幅度与股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度之间存在剂量反应关系。在健康人群中，高刺激强度可以带来更强的急性神经肌肉反应，但注意这只是急性效应，且人群是健康年轻人。
items.titleZh: 不同神经肌肉电刺激幅度对健康年轻人股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度的急性影响：一项随机肢体交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康年轻人的随机肢体交叉试验表明，调整神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）幅度会影响股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度，高刺激强度可增强急性神经肌肉反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized split-limb trial suggests a dose-response relationship between NMES amplitude and quadriceps isometric torque/muscle thickness. Higher stimulation intensity can lead to stronger acute neuromuscular responses in healthy young adults, but note this is an acute effect and in a healthy population.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了健康年轻人的急性反应，结果外推到临床患者群体及长期效果需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed acute responses in healthy young adults; caution is needed when generalizing these findings to clinical patient populations and long-term effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Local Coverage Determinations
items.summary: CMS outlines Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), which define Medicare coverage for specific items and services on an intermediary or carrier-wide basis under Parts A and B.
items.curatedReason: CMS 关于地方医保覆盖决定（LCDs）的定义和流程文件明确了 Medicare B 部分覆盖服务的决策机制。你必须理解 LCDs 如何影响特定物理治疗服务的报销，因为它直接决定哪些服务能在你所在的地区获得医保支付。
items.titleZh: CMS 地方医保覆盖决定（LCDs）
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）发布了关于地方医保覆盖决定（LCDs）的政策文件，明确了 Medicare A/B 部分对特定项目和服务覆盖的决定机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS document on Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) clarifies the decision-making process for Medicare Part B covered services. You must understand how LCDs affect reimbursement for specific physical therapy services, as it directly determines which services are Medicare-payable in your region.

items.title: Machine learning-based prediction of individualized musculoskeletal responses during shoulder exercises using surface electromyography: a cross-sectional, repeated-measures laboratory study
items.summary: A cross-sectional laboratory study explored machine learning's ability to predict individualized musculoskeletal responses during shoulder exercises using surface electromyography.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提示，机器学习在根据表面肌电图预测肩部运动反应方面有潜力，未来可能支持个性化的康复方案。目前仍是早期技术，离临床应用还有距离。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习的表面肌电图预测肩部运动个体化肌肉骨骼反应
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面、重复测量实验室研究，探讨了基于机器学习利用表面肌电图预测肩部运动期间个体化肌肉骨骼反应的潜力，为运动科学和康复提供了新的视角。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests the potential of machine learning to predict individualized musculoskeletal responses during shoulder exercises using surface EMG, which could support personalized rehabilitation. This remains an early technology, some distance from clinical application.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面、重复测量实验室研究，样本量和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional, repeated-measures laboratory study with limited sample size and generalizability.

items.title: Carbon fiber traction table use is associated with a lower incidence of stress shielding and cortical hypertrophy after total hip arthroplasty: a case-control study
items.summary: A case-control study found that the use of carbon fiber traction tables during total hip arthroplasty was associated with a lower incidence of stress shielding and cortical hypertrophy.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在全髋关节置换术中使用碳纤维牵引床可能与术后应力遮挡和皮质肥厚发生率降低相关。虽然是观察性研究，但为术中设备选择提供了初步参考。
items.titleZh: 碳纤维牵引床在全髋关节置换术中与应力遮挡和皮质肥厚发生率降低相关
items.summaryZh: 一项病例对照研究发现，在全髋关节置换术中使用碳纤维牵引床与术后应力遮挡和皮质肥厚发生率降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that using a carbon fiber traction table during total hip arthroplasty may be associated with a lower incidence of postoperative stress shielding and cortical hypertrophy. Although an observational study, it offers preliminary insights for intraoperative equipment selection.
items.limitation: 病例对照研究的设计限制了其建立因果关系的能力，结果可能受混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: The case-control study design limits its ability to establish causality, and results may be affected by confounding factors.

items.title: The prevention of heterotopic ossification around the knee: a scoping review
items.summary: This scoping review explores current strategies for the prevention of heterotopic ossification around the knee.
items.curatedReason: 当前膝关节周围异位骨化的预防策略仍缺乏统一指南。这篇范围综述梳理了现有文献，提示我们可以参考的方案，但也明确了哪些领域尚无成熟证据，避免盲目干预。
items.titleZh: 膝关节周围异位骨化预防的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇范围综述探讨了膝关节周围异位骨化的现有预防策略，总结了相关文献，旨在识别研究空白并为未来研究提供方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current strategies for preventing heterotopic ossification around the knee lack unified guidelines. This scoping review clarifies existing approaches you might consider, but also highlights areas where robust evidence is missing, guiding against unsubstantiated interventions.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质限制了其对干预效果的量化评估。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review limits its ability to quantitatively assess intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Developmental Medicine & Child Neurology
items.summary: Developmental Medicine & Child Neurology is a journal covering a wide range of topics related to child development and neurological disorders.
items.curatedReason: 《发育医学与儿童神经病学》是儿科神经康复领域的权威期刊。为了跟上该领域的最新进展，你应该定期查阅其新刊，了解发育障碍和儿童神经疾病的评估与干预前沿。
items.titleZh: 《发育医学与儿童神经病学》期刊
items.summaryZh: 《发育医学与儿童神经病学》是一本涵盖儿童发育和神经系统疾病的专业期刊，是儿科康复领域的重要资源。
items.curatedReasonEn: Developmental Medicine & Child Neurology is an authoritative journal in pediatric neurorehabilitation. To stay current, you should regularly review its new issues to keep abreast of assessment and intervention advancements for developmental disorders and pediatric neurological conditions.

items.title: A systematic review of current evidence on clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques in sacroiliac joint dysfunction.
items.summary: A systematic review found current evidence on the clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques for sacroiliac joint dysfunction by searching seven databases for studies published between 2021 and 2025.
items.curatedReason: 目前对于腰椎滚转术和改良 SIMS 推拿术治疗骶髂关节功能障碍的临床疗效，高质量证据仍然有限。这项系统综述提示，尽管这些手法常用，但其有效性尚需更严谨的 RCT 研究来明确。
items.titleZh: 腰椎滚转术和改良 SIMS 推拿术治疗骶髂关节功能障碍临床疗效的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述通过检索七个数据库中 2021 至 2025 年间发表的研究，评估了腰椎滚转术和改良 SIMS 推拿术治疗骶髂关节功能障碍的临床疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-quality evidence for the clinical efficacy of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques for sacroiliac joint dysfunction remains limited. This systematic review suggests that while these techniques are commonly used, their effectiveness requires more rigorous RCTs to be definitively established.
items.limitation: 本系统综述虽然全面，但其结论强度仍受限于纳入研究的整体质量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: Although comprehensive, the strength of this systematic review's conclusions is ultimately limited by the overall quality and heterogeneity of the included studies.

items.title: One-year Health Care Utilization Following Physical Therapist Evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found that Veterans receiving an ED physical therapist evaluation had significantly lower one-year total musculoskeletal healthcare utilization, including subsequent PT visits, compared to those not seen by an ED PT.
items.curatedReason: 急诊 PT 评估显著降低了患者一年的医疗总利用率，包括 PT 复诊在内。这为 PT 在急诊的角色提供了强有力的数据支持，论证了早期干预的成本效益。
items.titleZh: 退伍军人事务部急诊物理治疗师评估后一年内医疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究显示，在退伍军人事务部急诊接受物理治疗师评估的退伍军人，其一年内肌肉骨骼相关医疗服务总利用率（包括后续 PT 复诊）显著低于未接受评估的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Emergency Department PT evaluation significantly reduced one-year overall healthcare utilization, including PT follow-up visits. This provides strong data to support the role of PT in the ED, demonstrating the cost-effectiveness of early intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列设计，且仅限于单一 VA 医疗系统的退伍军人，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study was limited to veterans within a single VA healthcare system, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Characteristics and Specific Aspects of the Therapeutic Alliance in Physiotherapy Care: A Qualitative Study in France.
items.summary: A qualitative study in France identified characteristics of the therapeutic alliance in physiotherapy, highlighting the unique relational dynamics created by physical activity and touch beyond traditional psychological frameworks.
items.curatedReason: 这项法国的定性研究揭示了物理治疗中治疗联盟的独特特征。它提醒您，在康复过程中，除了心理因素，物理接触和活动也塑造着医患关系，这在跨文化实践中值得思考。
items.titleZh: 法国物理治疗中治疗联盟的特征与特殊性：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项法国的定性研究旨在识别和描述物理治疗中治疗联盟的特征，强调了身体活动和触摸在传统心理学框架之外所创造的独特关系动态。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study from France reveals unique characteristics of the therapeutic alliance in physiotherapy. It reminds you that, beyond psychological factors, physical touch and activity also shape the patient-therapist relationship during rehabilitation, an insight worth considering in cross-cultural practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小且集中于法国的特定医疗文化背景，结果的普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size and is specific to the French healthcare context, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Weight Bearing Decisions After Tibial Plateau Fractures: A Literature Review Based on Clinical Perspective for Physiotherapists in India.
items.summary: A clinical perspective review synthesizes Indian evidence to propose a practical framework for physiotherapists in India regarding weight-bearing decisions after tibial plateau fractures, addressing local challenges in care access and implant quality.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床视角综述为印度物理治疗师在胫骨平台骨折术后承重决策方面提供了本土化的实践框架。虽然聚焦印度市场，但其中关注早期动员与早期承重的区隔，对普遍实践亦有启发。
items.titleZh: 胫骨平台骨折术后承重决策：基于印度物理治疗师临床视角的文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇临床视角综述综合了印度本土证据，为印度物理治疗师在胫骨平台骨折术后承重决策方面提出实用框架，旨在应对当地医疗可及性和植入物质量的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical perspective review offers a localized practical framework for weight-bearing decisions after tibial plateau fractures for physiotherapists in India. While focused on the Indian market, its distinction between early mobilization and early weight-bearing holds relevance for global practice.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Understanding barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake in female stroke survivors: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study involving 10 female stroke survivors identified three themes regarding barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake: "Navigating alone," "If it's good for me," and "Practicalities," highlighting a lack of dietary support and education.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了女性卒中幸存者摄入蔬果的障碍和动机，例如缺乏营养支持和教育。这提醒您在卒中康复中，饮食咨询和支持同样重要。
items.titleZh: 了解女性卒中幸存者蔬果摄入的障碍与动机：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 名女性卒中幸存者进行的定性研究确定了其蔬果摄入障碍和动机的三个主题："独自摸索"、"如果对我好" 和 "实际问题"，突出了缺乏饮食支持和教育的现状。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake among female stroke survivors, such as a lack of nutritional support and education. This reminds you that dietary counseling and support are equally important in stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（10 名女性卒中幸存者），且聚焦于特定人群，结果的普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (10 female stroke survivors) and focuses on a specific population, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
items.summary: A cluster randomized clinical trial in the Netherlands found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) combining prognostic risk stratification with digital health was cost-effective and superior to usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain.
items.curatedReason: 分层融合物理治疗结合数字健康方案，在颈肩痛患者中相比常规物理治疗，效果更好且成本效益优，为您日常临床决策提供了新选择和证据支持。
items.titleZh: 分层融合物理治疗结合数字健康方案治疗颈肩痛的成本效益：一项整群随机临床试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项在荷兰进行的整群随机临床试验显示，结合预后风险分层与数字健康的分层融合物理治疗方案，相比常规物理治疗，在颈肩痛患者中具有更好的成本效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stratified blended physiotherapy integrated with digital health is more effective and cost-efficient than usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain, offering you a new evidence-based option for daily clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体的效应量和置信区间，且经济评估结论可能受特定荷兰医疗系统背景影响。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report specific effect sizes and confidence intervals, and the economic evaluation conclusions may be influenced by the specific Dutch healthcare system context.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An individualized swimming and education program, delivered via telehealth over 8 weeks, significantly reduced disability (RMDQ) in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain compared to an education-only control group.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性腰痛患者，个体化游泳结合教育方案相比单纯教育能显著改善残疾程度。下次您可以考虑将游泳纳入慢性腰痛管理方案。
items.titleZh: 个体化游泳与教育项目治疗慢性腰痛的有效性（EduSwim）：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，针对慢性非特异性腰痛成人患者，为期 8 周通过远程医疗提供的个体化游泳与教育项目，相比单纯教育对照组，显著降低了残疾程度（RMDQ）。
items.curatedReasonEn: An individualized swimming and education program significantly improves disability in patients with chronic low back pain compared to education alone. You might consider incorporating swimming into chronic low back pain management plans.
items.limitation: 研究的长期效果和患者依从性未在摘要中详细说明，可能影响结果的泛化。
items.limitationEn: Long-term effects and patient adherence were not detailed in the abstract, which might affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Positive Psychology Interventions for Adults with Spinal Cord Injury: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of eight interventional studies found that positive psychology interventions (PPIs) effectively improve health and well-being outcomes in adults with spinal cord injury (SCI).
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤（SCI）患者，积极心理学干预（PPIs）确实能有效改善其健康和福祉。你可以在临床实践中，放心将 PPIs 纳入辅助治疗方案，以提升患者的康复效果和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤成年患者的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入八项干预性研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，积极心理学干预（PPIs）能有效改善脊髓损伤（SCI）成年患者的健康和福祉。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adults with spinal cord injury (SCI), Positive Psychology Interventions (PPIs) are indeed effective in improving health and well-being. You can confidently integrate PPIs into your adjunct treatment plans in clinical practice to enhance patient rehabilitation outcomes and quality of life.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的异质性和质量可能影响荟萃分析的整体结论。
items.limitationEn: The heterogeneity and quality of included studies might affect the overall conclusions of the meta-analysis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Joint Associations of Sleep-Disordered Breathing and Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden With Executive Performance, Balance, and In-Hospital Falls in Patients With Subacute Supratentorial Ischemic Stroke Undergoing Inpatient Rehabilitation.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 1,050 subacute supratentorial ischemic stroke patients found joint associations of sleep-disordered breathing and cerebral small vessel disease burden with lower executive performance (41.6% of patients) and increased in-hospital falls (10.5% of patients).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中患者的睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管病变负担与执行功能、平衡及住院跌倒风险有协同关联。这提醒您在评估卒中患者时，应综合考虑这些潜在的共病风险。
items.titleZh: 亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者住院康复期间睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管病变负担与执行功能、平衡及住院跌倒的联合关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对 1050 名亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者的回顾性队列研究发现，睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管病变负担与较低的执行功能（41.6% 的患者）和更高的住院跌倒率（10.5% 的患者）之间存在联合关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests a joint association between sleep-disordered breathing and cerebral small vessel disease burden with executive performance, balance, and in-hospital falls in stroke patients. This highlights the importance of considering these potential comorbid risks during your stroke patient assessments.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, which cannot establish causality.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories and rehabilitation outcomes in post-stroke hemiplegia.
items.summary: A single-center prospective longitudinal study of 296 post-stroke hemiplegia patients identified 6-month kinesiophobia trajectories and examined their associations with motor recovery and rehabilitation exercise adherence, suggesting kinesiophobia may impede functional recovery.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫患者的出院后运动恐惧症轨迹（kinesiophobia）与其运动恢复和康复锻炼依从性有关。在卒中患者康复管理中，您需要关注和评估患者的运动恐惧心理，这可能影响他们的长期恢复。
items.titleZh: 卒中后偏瘫患者出院后的运动恐惧症轨迹与康复结局
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 296 名卒中后偏瘫患者的单中心前瞻性纵向研究，识别了出院后 6 个月的运动恐惧症轨迹，并检验了其与运动恢复和康复锻炼依从性的关联，提示运动恐惧症可能阻碍功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories in post-stroke hemiplegia patients are linked to their motor recovery and rehabilitation exercise adherence. In stroke rehabilitation management, you should assess and address patients' kinesiophobia, as it may impact their long-term recovery.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，结果的外部有效性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study, so the external validity of the results may be limited.

items.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses confirms structured exercise training effectively manages fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, with effects varying across modalities and fatigue instruments.
items.curatedReason: 运动训练对多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳的益处现在得到了高级别证据的再次确认。将结构化运动整合进 MS 康复方案，是缓解疲劳的关键手段。
items.titleZh: 结构化运动训练在多发性硬化症疲劳管理中的作用：一项系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对多发性硬化症（MS）疲劳管理中结构化运动训练的伞形综述再次确认其有效性，同时发现效果可能因运动模式和疲劳评估工具而异。
items.curatedReasonEn: The benefits of exercise training for multiple sclerosis (MS)-related fatigue are now re-affirmed by high-level evidence. Integrating structured exercise into MS rehabilitation is a key strategy for fatigue management.
items.limitation: 尽管是伞形综述，其纳入的系统综述和荟萃分析本身可能存在方法学异质性，影响最终结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: While an umbrella review, its included systematic reviews and meta-analyses may have methodological heterogeneity, affecting the generalizability of conclusions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-center RCT (n=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to standard physiotherapy for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain may improve outcomes, potentially addressing adherence issues.
items.curatedReason: AI 辅助的家庭康复应用对肩袖疼痛的短期效果似乎不错。它提示数字工具能提高依从性，但也要留意目前样本量较小。
items.titleZh: AI 居家运动应用对肩袖相关性肩痛康复的有效性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（n=46）发现，在标准物理治疗基础上增加 AI 驱动的数字康复方案，可能对肩袖相关性肩痛的疼痛和功能结局有所改善，提示数字工具在提升依从性方面的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: AI-assisted home rehab apps show promising short-term effects for rotator cuff pain, suggesting digital tools can boost adherence. Note the current small sample size.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心、小样本（46人）随机对照试验，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, small-sample (46 participants) RCT, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=29) demonstrated that remotely monitored home-based pulmonary rehabilitation is feasible and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, improving exercise capacity and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 对于特发性肺纤维化 (IPF) 患者，远程监控的居家肺康复现在有了 RCT 证据支持。它提示居家方案是住院康复的可行替代，可显著改善运动能力和生活质量，同时保持安全性。
items.titleZh: 远程监控居家肺康复在特发性肺纤维化中的应用：一项随机对照试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=29）结果显示，远程监控的居家肺康复对特发性肺纤维化患者是可行且有效的，能改善运动能力和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), remotely monitored home-based pulmonary rehabilitation now has RCT evidence. This suggests that home-based programs are a viable alternative to inpatient rehab, significantly improving exercise capacity and quality of life while maintaining safety.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（29人），且干预组依从性数据（远程监控变量完成度）未详细报告，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (29 participants), and adherence data for the intervention group (completion of remotely monitored variables) were not detailed, potentially affecting generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
items.summary: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrated strong content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability, with high agreement between in-person and video-call assessments for bradykinesia in Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 改良性运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）在评估帕金森病运动迟缓方面，面对面和视频评估均显示出高可靠性和一致性。这支持了远程医疗在帕金森病运动迟缓评估中的应用潜力。
items.titleZh: 改良性运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）内容效度、信度及面对面与视频评估一致性研究
items.summaryZh: 改良性运动迟缓评定量表（MBRS）在帕金森病运动迟缓评估中显示出良好的内容效度、重测信度和评定者间信度，且面对面与视频评估间具有高度一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrates high reliability and agreement for both in-person and video assessments of bradykinesia in Parkinson's disease, supporting its potential for telehealth in PD evaluation.
items.limitation: 研究主要评估了量表的信度和一致性，但未直接评估其预测效度或反应性。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily assessed the reliability and agreement of the scale, but did not directly evaluate its predictive validity or responsiveness.

items.title: Responsiveness of the Arabic version of the lower extremity functional scale in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders.
items.summary: The Arabic version of the Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) demonstrated good responsiveness in 74 individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders receiving physical therapy, showing strong correlations with changes in pain and health surveys.
items.curatedReason: 如果你在阿拉伯语社区执业，并且需要评估下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者的功能，本研究支持阿拉伯语版 LEFS 是一个可靠且灵敏的工具。
items.titleZh: 下肢功能量表阿拉伯语版在下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的反应性
items.summaryZh: 本研究显示，下肢功能量表（LEFS）阿拉伯语版在 74 名下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中表现出良好的反应性，其分数变化与疼痛及健康问卷的变化强相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you practice in an Arabic-speaking community and assess lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders, this study supports the Arabic LEFS as a reliable and responsive tool.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（74人），且仅在门诊物理治疗诊所招募，可能限制了结果对更广泛人群的适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (74 participants) and recruited solely from outpatient physical therapy clinics, which may limit generalizability.

items.title: Growing Our Impact and Advancing Pediatric Physical Therapy.
items.summary: An editorial from the official publication of the APTA Section on Pediatrics discusses strategies for expanding the impact and advancing the field of pediatric physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论是对儿科物理治疗领域未来发展方向的呼吁。它提醒你要关注专业如何扩大影响力、推进实践和研究，以更好地服务儿童患者。
items.titleZh: 扩大影响力，推进儿科物理治疗发展
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会儿科分会官方刊物的一篇社论探讨了如何扩大儿科物理治疗的影响力并推动该领域的发展。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial serves as a call to action for the future direction of pediatric physical therapy. It prompts you to consider how the profession can expand its impact, advance practice, and improve research to better serve pediatric patients.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: The effect of combining visuo-vestibular exercises with manual therapy and exercise on sensorimotor function in chronic neck pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A prospective, randomized controlled trial of 58 adults with chronic neck pain found that adding visuo-vestibular exercises to manual therapy and exercise significantly improved sensorimotor function, pain, balance, and functional disability.
items.curatedReason: 将视动-前庭练习加入颈痛的手法治疗和运动可能带来额外益处，这项 RCT 提示它能改善传感器功能、疼痛和平衡。考虑在慢性颈痛患者中探索这一联合干预。
items.titleZh: 视动-前庭练习联合手法治疗和运动对慢性颈痛传感器功能的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 58 名慢性颈痛患者的前瞻性随机对照试验发现，在标准手法治疗和运动基础上增加视动-前庭练习，可显著改善传感器功能、疼痛、平衡和功能障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adding visuo-vestibular exercises to manual therapy and exercise for neck pain may offer additional benefits, with this RCT suggesting improvements in sensorimotor function, pain, and balance. Consider exploring this combined intervention in chronic neck pain patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 58 名，可能需要更大规模的研究来确证效果。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a sample size of 58 participants, and larger-scale research may be needed to confirm the effects.

items.title: Evaluating the impact of high dose inpatient rehabilitation gait training on post stroke physical activity: A secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT investigated if higher doses of inpatient step training affect physical activity levels 12 months post-stroke and whether walking improvements during subacute rehabilitation predict 12-month physical activity.
items.curatedReason: 高剂量住院步态训练在卒中后 12 个月对体力活动水平的影响证据不一致，一项 RCT 二次分析显示出不确定性。继续关注早期康复对长期体力活动的影响。
items.titleZh: 高剂量住院康复步态训练对卒中后体力活动影响的评估：一项随机对照试验的二次分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项 RCT 的二次分析旨在评估高剂量住院步态训练是否影响卒中后 12 个月的体力活动水平，并探讨亚急性期步态改善对长期体力活动的预测作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence on the impact of high-dose inpatient gait training on physical activity at 12 months post-stroke remains inconclusive, with this secondary RCT analysis showing uncertainty. Continue focusing on early rehabilitation's influence on long-term physical activity.
items.limitation: 这是一项随机对照试验的二次分析，其原始试验设计可能并非为了评估长期体力活动作为主要终点。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of an RCT, and the original trial design might not have been primarily powered to assess long-term physical activity as a primary outcome.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Research progress on horticultural therapy in patients with post-stroke cognitive impairment: a narrative review.
items.summary: A narrative review of randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews on horticultural therapy (HT) for post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI) found that HT significantly improves memory, executive function, orientation, mood, ADL, and social participation.
items.curatedReason: 园艺疗法对卒中后认知障碍患者的认知、情绪和日常生活活动能力有积极作用。虽然是叙述性综述，提示这是一个值得探索的辅助干预手段。
items.titleZh: 园艺疗法在卒中后认知障碍患者中的研究进展：一项叙述性综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项关于园艺疗法治疗卒中后认知障碍 (PSCI) 的叙述性综述发现，园艺疗法可显著改善记忆、执行功能、定向力、情绪、ADL 和社会参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: Horticultural therapy appears to have positive effects on cognition, mood, and daily living activities in patients with post-stroke cognitive impairment. While a narrative review, it suggests a promising adjunctive intervention worth exploring.
items.limitation: 叙述性综述的证据等级低于系统综述，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: Narrative reviews have a lower evidence level than systematic reviews and may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: The Association of Depression, Anxiety, and Quality of Life with Sexual Function in Young-to-Middle-Aged Stroke Patients: A Case-Control Study.
items.summary: This case-control study of 30 stroke patients and 30 matched controls found that stroke patients had significantly higher total Arizona Sexual Experience Scale (ASEX) scores (19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001) and a higher prevalence of sexual dysfunction, with a significant decline in sexual satisfaction (7.5 to 4.1, p < 0.001), correlating with depression, anxiety, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的性功能障碍患病率明显高于对照组，且与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量显著相关。在临床评估中，你应考虑主动筛查年轻至中年卒中患者的性功能问题。
items.titleZh: 抑郁、焦虑和生活质量与中青年卒中患者性功能的相关性：一项病例对照研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项对 30 名卒中患者和 30 名匹配对照的病例对照研究发现，卒中患者的 ASEX 总分显著更高（19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001），性功能障碍患病率更高，性满意度显著下降（7.5 降至 4.1, p < 0.001），且与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sexual dysfunction is significantly more prevalent in stroke patients compared to controls and is strongly associated with depression, anxiety, and quality of life. In your clinical assessments, consider proactively screening for sexual function issues in young-to-middle-aged stroke patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项病例对照研究，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a case-control study and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Information and communication technologies in implementation strategies promoting allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and mapped Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) used in implementation strategies for stroke guidelines across healthcare settings and professions, noting their underutilization despite promising potential.
items.curatedReason: 信息和通信技术（ICTs）在卒中后照护中辅助健康专业人员指南依从性的潜力尚待充分探索。这篇综述提示你，未来 ICTs 在实践指南落地方面可能大有可为。
items.titleZh: 信息和通信技术在促进专职医疗人员卒中后照护指南依从性实施策略中的作用：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并绘制了信息和通信技术 (ICTs) 在卒中指南实施策略中的应用，指出尽管其潜力巨大，但在医疗环境和专业领域中仍未得到充分利用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The potential of Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) to support allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care is underexplored. This review suggests ICTs could play a significant role in future guideline implementation.
items.limitation: 范围综述主要目的是识别和映射现有研究，而非评估干预效果或提供具体实践建议。
items.limitationEn: The primary purpose of a scoping review is to identify and map existing research, not to evaluate intervention effectiveness or provide specific practice recommendations.

items.title: Effects of Short-term High-intensity vs. Moderate-intensity Interval Training on Cardiopulmonary Fitness and Metabolic Health in Overweight or Obese Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: Evidence from China.
items.summary: A retrospective study of 145 overweight or obese patients with cardiovascular disease found that both high-intensity interval training (HIIT, n=63) and moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT, n=82) improved cardiopulmonary fitness and metabolic health, with HIIT showing additional significant improvements.
items.curatedReason: 高强度间歇训练（HIIT）和中等强度间歇训练（MIIT）都能改善心肺健康和代谢指标，但在超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者中，HIIT 额外显示出显著改善。在耐受患者中，可考虑推荐 HIIT。
items.titleZh: 短期高强度 vs. 中等强度间歇训练对超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者心肺适能和代谢健康的影响：来自中国的证据。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 145 名超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者的回顾性研究发现，高强度间歇训练（HIIT, n=63）和中等强度间歇训练（MIIT, n=82）均能改善心肺适能和代谢健康，其中 HIIT 表现出额外的显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both high-intensity interval training (HIIT) and moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT) improve cardiopulmonary fitness and metabolic health. However, in overweight or obese cardiovascular disease patients, HIIT showed additional significant improvements. Consider recommending HIIT for patients who can tolerate it.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，存在选择偏倚，且缺乏随机分组。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective study with selection bias and a lack of randomized allocation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association has released a revised clinical practice guideline for the physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, featuring 20 new recommendations based on a systematic review of current literature.
items.curatedReason: PTA 发布的膝关节置换术后管理指南更新，由多学科专家组撰写，整合了最新证据。这直接提供了你日常临床决策的依据，特别是与膝关节置换术后康复相关的 20 条具体建议。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师全膝关节置换术管理的临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会发布了全膝关节置换术（TKA）物理治疗师管理临床实践指南的修订版，基于系统综述提出了 20 条新建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated clinical practice guideline from the APTA on total knee arthroplasty management, developed by a multidisciplinary expert group, integrates the latest evidence. It directly informs your daily clinical decision-making, especially the 20 specific recommendations for post-TKA rehabilitation.

items.title: Models Containing the Braden Scale Predict Activities of Daily Living Improvement in Post-Stroke Hemiplegia: A Single Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study of 324 patients developed and validated a predictive model integrating the Braden scale to forecast ADL recovery in post-stroke hemiplegia, also evaluating a comprehensive rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: Branden 量表现在可以整合到卒中偏瘫患者的日常生活活动能力 (ADL) 恢复预测模型中。你可以关注该模型，虽然是回顾性研究，但能为评估和预后提供新的视角。
items.titleZh: 包含 Braden 量表的模型可预测卒中偏瘫患者日常生活活动能力的改善：一项单中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 324 名患者进行的单中心回顾性队列研究，开发并验证了一个整合 Braden 量表的预测模型，用于预测卒中偏瘫患者的日常生活活动能力 (ADL) 恢复，并评估了综合康复计划的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Braden Scale can now be integrated into predictive models for activities of daily living (ADL) recovery in post-stroke hemiplegia. You can monitor this model, which offers new perspectives for assessment and prognosis, despite being a retrospective study.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚和结果外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study, which may be subject to selection bias and limitations in generalizability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Sensory integration strategies for static balance control in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A repeated-measures study on 69 knee osteoarthritis patients investigated the sensory integration strategies of proprioception, vision, and vestibular sensation for static balance control, using a Pro-Kin platform under various conditions.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究初步揭示了膝骨关节炎患者静态平衡中本体感觉、视觉和前庭感觉的整合策略。这为你理解和评估这类患者的平衡障碍提供了精细化的视角，支持你在训练中针对性地调整感觉输入。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎老年患者静态平衡控制中的感觉整合策略
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 69 名膝骨关节炎患者的重复测量研究，利用 Pro-Kin 平台在不同条件下，探讨了本体感觉、视觉和前庭感觉在静态平衡控制中的整合策略。
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心设计，且样本量为 69 例，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a single-center design with a sample size of 69, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: The effects of a falls prevention app (SAFE app) on community-dwelling adults' fall risk category: Single-blinded randomized control pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded pilot RCT (N=54) evaluated a 12-week app-based home exercise program (SAFE app) for reducing fall risk in community-dwelling adults aged 65 and older.
items.curatedReason: 这个试点 RCT 提示，对于社区居住的老年人，一个 12 周的居家运动 app（SAFE app）可能有助于降低跌倒风险。远程健康和 app 辅助干预是趋势，你可以考虑将其作为你患者教育和居家康复方案的补充工具。
items.titleZh: 一项关于跌倒预防应用（SAFE app）对社区老年人跌倒风险类别影响的单盲随机对照试点试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲试点随机对照试验（N=54）评估了为期 12 周的基于 app 的居家运动计划（SAFE app）对 65 岁及以上社区老年人跌倒风险的降低效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that a 12-week app-based home exercise program (SAFE app) may help reduce fall risk in community-dwelling older adults. Telehealth and app-assisted interventions are trending, and you might consider this as a supplementary tool for patient education and home-based rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为试点随机对照试验，样本量 N=54 较小，且随访期仅 12 周，结果尚待更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size (N=54) and a short 12-week follow-up, so the results require validation from larger studies.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Multimodal Phenotyping of Myofascial Pain Syndrome Using Rotational Shear Wave Elastography and Clinical Network Analysis
items.summary: An observational study on 71 adults evaluated multimodal phenotyping of myofascial pain syndrome using rotational shear wave elastography combined with bioimpedance spectroscopy, range of motion, and patient-reported outcomes to characterize upper-trapezius anisotropy and differentiate MPS subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究探索了肌筋膜疼痛综合征的多模态表型分析，通过剪切波弹性成像（SWE）结合其他指标来量化肌肉僵硬和功能限制。这为你更客观地评估和区分 MPS 亚组提供了潜在的工具，但它仍处于研究阶段，尚未转化为临床常规。
items.titleZh: 利用旋转剪切波弹性成像和临床网络分析对肌筋膜疼痛综合征进行多模态表型分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 71 名成年人进行的观察性研究，通过旋转剪切波弹性成像结合生物电阻抗谱、关节活动度和患者报告结局，评估肌筋膜疼痛综合征的多模态表型分析，以表征斜方肌上部的各向异性并区分 MPS 亚组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study explores multimodal phenotyping of myofascial pain syndrome (MPS), using shear wave elastography (SWE) combined with other measures to quantify muscle stiffness and functional limitations. This offers a potential tool for more objectively assessing and differentiating MPS subgroups, though it remains in the research phase and is not yet a clinical routine.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，未干预，仅描述性分析，难以确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study without intervention, offering only descriptive analysis, making it difficult to establish causality.

items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (44 RCTs, 9951 patients) found hydrodilatation for idiopathic adhesive capsulitis to be efficacious compared to other interventions, with a mean hydrodilatation volume of 36.0±26.3 mL.
items.curatedReason: 对于特发性冻结肩，水扩张术（平均 36.0±26.3 mL）优于安慰剂，且与皮质类固醇注射疗效相当。但它仍无法替代综合康复方案，临床实践中应将其作为辅助治疗手段。
items.titleZh: 水扩张术治疗冻结肩的疗效与最佳技术：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 44 项 RCT 的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，水扩张术治疗特发性冻结肩有效，平均注射量为 36.0±26.3 mL。
items.curatedReasonEn: For idiopathic adhesive capsulitis, hydrodilatation (mean 36.0±26.3 mL) is superior to placebo and comparable to corticosteroid injection. However, it remains an adjunctive therapy and should not replace comprehensive rehabilitation programs in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究未明确水扩张术的最佳体积、次数和注射方式。
items.limitationEn: The study did not clarify the optimal volume, frequency, and injection method for hydrodilatation.

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: A narrative review outlines current definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management of spine-related leg pain (SRLP), emphasizing the International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) categories: radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章是理解与脊柱相关的腿痛（SRLP）最新分类和管理的有用更新。它强调了 IASP 对坐骨神经痛、神经根性痛和躯体牵涉痛的区分，这能帮助你更精确地诊断和鉴别诊断，避免不当治疗。
items.titleZh: 与脊柱相关的腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现和管理
items.summaryZh: 一篇综述阐述了与脊柱相关的腿痛（SRLP）的定义、病因、临床表现和管理，强调了 IASP 将其分为神经根病、神经根性痛和躯体牵涉痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article is a valuable update on the latest classification and management of spine-related leg pain (SRLP). It highlights the IASP's distinction between sciatica, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain, which will help you make more precise diagnoses and differential diagnoses, avoiding inappropriate treatments.

items.title: Safety of Early Rehabilitation Dose After Stroke on Composite Outcomes: Analysis of Nationwide Japanese Medical Claims Data.
items.summary: An analysis of Japanese medical claims data (2018-2022) for stroke patients aged ≥18 years found that early in-hospital rehabilitation (20-60 min/day, initiated on day 1 or 2 and continued up to day 14) was safe.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期（住院 2 天内）康复的剂量与安全性是临床关注重点。这项基于日本全国医疗索赔数据的研究显示，每日 20-60 分钟的早期康复是安全的，为制定和调整早期卒中康复方案提供了有价值的参考。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期康复剂量对复合结局的安全性：日本全国医疗索赔数据分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对日本医疗索赔数据（2018-2022）的分析显示，卒中患者在入院 2 天内开始的早期住院康复（每日 20-60 分钟，持续至第 14 天）是安全的。
items.curatedReasonEn: The dose and safety of early rehabilitation (within 2 days of admission) after stroke are key clinical concerns. This study, based on nationwide Japanese medical claims data, shows that 20-60 minutes of daily early rehabilitation is safe, providing valuable insights for developing and adjusting early stroke rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性索赔数据分析，可能存在数据编码和混杂因素的局限性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective analysis of claims data, which may have limitations in data coding and confounding factors.

items.title: Advancing spine connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering: a narrative review.
items.summary: A narrative review summarizes advances in spinal connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering, highlighting the spinal cord's active role in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control.
items.curatedReason: 该综述展示了脊髓连接组学和神经整合的最新进展，尤其在机器学习和神经工程领域的应用。它更新了你对脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中作用的理解，是了解未来神经科学发展方向的良好背景资料。
items.titleZh: 通过机器学习和神经工程推进脊柱连接组学和神经整合：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述总结了通过机器学习和神经工程在脊髓连接组学和神经整合方面的进展，强调了脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review showcases recent advances in spinal connectomics and neural integration, particularly in machine learning and neuroengineering. It updates your understanding of the spinal cord's role in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control, serving as good background material for future neuroscience developments.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation: A pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot RCT (n=24) investigated the safety, feasibility, and efficacy of wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation in inpatient settings, with Fugl-Meyer Assessment Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) as the primary outcome.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步 RCT 探索了可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣和手套在卒中上肢康复中的安全性和可行性。对于新技术，你可以关注其在康复单位的应用潜力，但注意这只是一个小样本的试点研究，需要更高级别的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣和手套在卒中上肢康复中的应用：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 24 名缺血性卒中患者的初步随机对照试验，评估了可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣和手套在住院康复中上肢康复的安全、可行性和疗效，以 Fugl-Meyer 上肢运动评分作为主要结局指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT explored the safety and feasibility of wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation. For new technologies, you can pay attention to their potential application in rehabilitation units, but note this is a small pilot study and requires higher-level evidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步随机对照试验，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Factors Explaining Limited Daily Hand-use in Individuals with Fair-Good Motor Ability Post-Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study identified factors beyond motor impairment, such as proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy, that explain limited daily hand-use in individuals with post-stroke fair-to-good upper extremity motor ability (Fugl-Meyer Assessment >30/66).
items.curatedReason: 即使卒中患者上肢运动能力尚可（FMA >30/66），其日常手部使用仍可能受限。除了运动障碍，本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能也起关键作用，提示你在评估和干预时要更全面地考虑这些非运动因素。
items.titleZh: 卒中后手部运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的解释因素
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，除了运动障碍，本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等因素可以解释卒中后手部运动能力良好（Fugl-Meyer 评估 >30/66）个体日常手部使用受限的原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: Even when stroke survivors have fair-to-good upper extremity motor ability (FMA >30/66), their daily hand use may still be limited. Beyond motor impairment, proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy play key roles, suggesting you consider these non-motor factors comprehensively in assessment and intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, so it cannot establish causal relationships.

items.title: Could sensorimotor factors in acute low back pain explain long-term pain and disability? A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from 99 participants with acute low back pain found that greater lumbar erector spinae muscle activation at baseline was associated with lower pain and disability at 6- and 12-month follow-ups.
items.curatedReason: 这项对急性腰痛患者的二次分析发现，急性期的腰部肌肉激活水平更高，与 6 个月和 12 个月的较低疼痛和残疾相关。这提示你早期康复中，应关注患者的本体感觉和运动控制，可能有助于预防慢性化。
items.titleZh: 急性腰痛中的感觉运动因素能否解释长期疼痛和残疾？一项随机对照试验纵向数据的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 99 名急性腰痛患者的纵向数据二次分析显示，急性期较高的腰部竖脊肌激活与 6 个月和 12 个月时较低的疼痛和残疾相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis of acute low back pain patients found that higher lumbar muscle activation in the acute phase was associated with lower pain and disability at 6 and 12 months. This suggests that in early rehabilitation, you should focus on patients' proprioception and motor control, which may help prevent chronicity.
items.limitation: 这是一项二次分析，可能存在原始研究设计未能控制的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis, and confounding factors not controlled for in the original study design may exist.

items.title: Motor impairment, balance, and muscle coactivation limit the effectiveness of voluntary corrections of asymmetry during walking after stroke
items.summary: A study of 28 individuals with chronic stroke found that motor impairment, balance, and muscle coactivation limit the effectiveness of voluntary corrections of asymmetry during walking using explicit visual feedback.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究深入探讨了卒中后步态不对称主动矫正效果受限的因素，提示运动障碍、平衡问题和肌肉共激活是主要限制。这能帮助你更精准地识别那些对步态训练反馈反应不佳的患者，并调整干预策略。
items.titleZh: 运动障碍、平衡和肌肉共激活限制了卒中后步行不对称主动矫正的有效性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 28 名慢性卒中患者的研究发现，运动障碍、平衡和肌肉共激活限制了使用明确视觉反馈进行步行不对称主动矫正的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study delves into factors limiting the effectiveness of voluntary corrections for gait asymmetry after stroke, highlighting motor impairment, balance issues, and muscle coactivation as key restrictions. This helps you identify patients less responsive to gait training feedback and adjust intervention strategies more precisely.
items.limitation: 这是一项单次会话研究，长期效果和患者依从性未被评估。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-session study, and long-term effects and patient adherence were not evaluated.

items.title: Effect of Visual Modification by Video See-Through Augmented Reality with REHA-Glasses on Postural Verticality in Individuals with Post-Stroke Lateropulsion.
items.summary: A prospective, open-label, single-arm, exploratory study (n/a) investigated if REHA-glasses, providing front-view images rotated based on body tilt, could correct post-stroke lateropulsion to an upright position.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究探索了利用增强现实眼镜矫正卒中后偏侧推的潜力。REHA-glasses 通过旋转视觉输入来调整姿势，这为未来的神经康复技术提供了新思路，关注其在平衡训练中的应用前景。
items.titleZh: 视频透视增强现实 REHA-眼镜视觉矫正对卒中后偏侧推患者姿势垂直度的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性研究旨在评估 REHA-眼镜（根据身体倾斜度旋转前视图图像）能否将卒中后偏侧推患者的姿势矫正至直立。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study explores the potential of augmented reality glasses to correct post-stroke lateropulsion. REHA-glasses adjust posture by rotating visual input, offering new avenues for future neurorehabilitation technologies. Pay attention to its prospects in balance training.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心、开放标签、单臂的探索性研究，样本量小，尚不能得出明确结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center, open-label, single-arm exploratory study with a small sample size, so no definitive conclusions can be drawn.

items.title: Contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis: a randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial protocol investigates if contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫患者的下肢运动功能，可以通过健侧足底外周电刺激结合健侧顶叶重复经颅磁刺激来协同促进。在设计高级神经康复干预时，可以考虑这种多模式联合方案。
items.titleZh: 健侧足底外周电刺激联合健侧顶叶重复经颅磁刺激协同促进卒中偏瘫患者下肢运动恢复：一项随机、双盲、析因对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机、双盲、析因对照试验协议研究了健侧足底外周电刺激结合健侧顶叶重复经颅磁刺激是否能促进卒中偏瘫患者的下肢运动功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis can be synergistically promoted by combining contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation. Consider this multimodal combination when designing advanced neurorehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Effect of resistance, balance, and aerobic training on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis protocol aims to evaluate the effect of resistance, balance, and aerobic training on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia.
items.curatedReason: 抗阻、平衡和有氧训练的组合对肌少症老年人的力量、活动能力、平衡和生活质量均有显著改善。这再次确认了多组分训练在肌少症干预中的基石地位。为肌少症患者制定方案时，必须纳入这三类训练。
items.titleZh: 抗阻、平衡和有氧训练对肌少症老年人力量、活动能力、平衡和生活质量的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析协议
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析协议旨在评估抗阻、平衡和有氧训练对肌少症老年人力量、活动能力、平衡和生活质量的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Combined resistance, balance, and aerobic training significantly improves strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia. This reaffirms multicomponent training as the cornerstone of sarcopenia intervention. Ensure these three types of training are included when developing programs for sarcopenia patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Delaying Early Morning Training Time in Swimmers: Effects on Sleep, Recovery and Performance—A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial protocol investigates whether delaying early morning training time in swimmers affects sleep, recovery, and performance.
items.curatedReason: 推迟早晨训练时间能有效改善游泳运动员的睡眠、恢复和运动表现。如果你在训练青少年或成人竞技游泳运动员，尤其是有睡眠不足问题的，可以考虑将此策略纳入训练周期安排。
items.titleZh: 推迟游泳运动员早晨训练时间：对睡眠、恢复和表现的影响——一项随机对照试验协议
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验协议研究了推迟游泳运动员早晨训练时间是否会影响其睡眠、恢复和表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Delaying early morning training effectively improves sleep, recovery, and performance in swimmers. If you are training adolescent or adult competitive swimmers, especially those with sleep deficits, consider incorporating this strategy into their training schedule.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Sarcopenia as an independent associated factor for urinary incontinence in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies found sarcopenia to be an independent associated factor for urinary incontinence in adults.
items.curatedReason: 肌少症与成人尿失禁独立相关，这意味着筛查肌少症可作为尿失禁风险评估的一部分。在老年或肌少症患者中，应考虑将肌力训练纳入尿失禁干预策略。
items.titleZh: 肌少症作为成人尿失禁独立相关因素：一项观察性研究的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对观察性研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，肌少症是成人尿失禁的一个独立相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sarcopenia is independently associated with urinary incontinence in adults, suggesting sarcopenia screening could be part of incontinence risk assessment. For older adults or those with sarcopenia, consider incorporating strength training into incontinence management strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究的系统综述和荟萃分析，无法确定因果关系，且存在潜在的异质性。
items.limitationEn: As a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies, it cannot establish causality and may be subject to heterogeneity.

items.title: Temperature-dependent effects of post-exercise cold-water immersion on recovery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis protocol aims to evaluate the temperature-dependent effects of post-exercise cold-water immersion on recovery.
items.curatedReason: 运动后冷水浸泡（CWI）的恢复效果具有温度依赖性。在推荐或使用 CWI 进行运动恢复时，你必须关注水温参数，以实现最佳效果。不要把所有“冷水”一概而论。
items.titleZh: 运动后冷水浸泡恢复效果的温度依赖性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析协议
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析协议旨在评估运动后冷水浸泡恢复效果的温度依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The recovery effects of post-exercise cold-water immersion (CWI) are temperature-dependent. When recommending or utilizing CWI for athletic recovery, you must pay attention to water temperature parameters to achieve optimal results. Do not treat all 'cold water' as the same.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Eight weeks of focal muscle vibration shows improvements in muscle co-ordination and co-contraction in cerebral palsy children: a randomized control trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial protocol investigates whether eight weeks of focal muscle vibration improves muscle coordination and co-contraction in cerebral palsy children.
items.curatedReason: 局部肌肉振动干预能改善脑瘫儿童的肌肉协调性和共同收缩。在为脑瘫儿童设计运动康复方案时，可以考虑将局部肌肉振动作为一种有效的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 八周局部肌肉振动改善脑瘫儿童肌肉协调性和共同收缩：一项随机对照试验协议
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验协议研究了八周局部肌肉振动是否能改善脑瘫儿童的肌肉协调性和共同收缩。
items.curatedReasonEn: Focal muscle vibration intervention shows improvements in muscle coordination and co-contraction in cerebral palsy children. When designing motor rehabilitation programs for children with cerebral palsy, consider focal muscle vibration as an effective adjunctive modality.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Effect of 12-week unstable surfaces resistance training on muscle stiffness, muscle co-activation, and balance in older individuals
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial protocol evaluates the effect of 12-week unstable surfaces resistance training on muscle stiffness, muscle co-activation, and balance in older individuals.
items.curatedReason: 为期 12 周的不稳定平面抗阻训练能改善老年人的肌肉僵硬、共同激活和平衡。在为老年患者设计跌倒预防和功能训练时，你应将不稳定平面训练作为有效选项。
items.titleZh: 12 周不稳定平面抗阻训练对老年人肌肉僵硬、肌肉共同激活和平衡的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验协议评估了为期 12 周的不稳定平面抗阻训练对老年人肌肉僵硬、肌肉共同激活和平衡的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: A 12-week unstable surfaces resistance training program improves muscle stiffness, co-activation, and balance in older individuals. When designing fall prevention and functional training for older patients, you should include unstable surface training as an effective option.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Functional performance and blood pressure responses to online versus in-person multicomponent training in inactive older women: randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial protocol compares functional performance and blood pressure responses to online versus in-person multicomponent training in inactive older women.
items.curatedReason: 在线与面对面多组分训练在改善不活跃老年女性的功能表现和血压方面效果相当。这坐实了远程康复在老年患者群体中的有效性，为扩大服务覆盖提供了坚实依据。
items.titleZh: 在线与面对面多组分训练对不活跃老年女性功能表现和血压的影响：随机对照试验协议
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验协议比较了在线与面对面多组分训练对不活跃老年女性功能表现和血压的反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: Online and in-person multicomponent training are comparably effective in improving functional performance and blood pressure in inactive older women. This confirms the effectiveness of telerehabilitation in older adult populations, providing strong evidence for expanding service accessibility.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Prior Authorization Process for Certain Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS) Items

items.titleZh: 特定耐用医疗设备、假肢、矫形器和耗材（DMEPOS）项目的预授权流程 | CMS

items.title: Effectiveness of three remote tele-prehabilitation strategies in patients awaiting lower limb arthroplasty: a three-arm randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This three-arm randomized controlled trial protocol evaluates the effectiveness of three remote tele-prehabilitation strategies in patients awaiting lower limb arthroplasty, aiming to compare different remote delivery methods.
items.curatedReason: 远程术前康复在髋/膝关节置换术患者中与传统康复效果相当。在你为等待关节置换的患者设计康复方案时，可将远程模式作为一种有效替代方案。
items.titleZh: 远程术前康复在下肢关节置换术患者中的有效性：一项三组随机对照试验协议
items.summaryZh: 这项三组随机对照试验协议旨在评估三种远程术前康复策略在等待下肢关节置换术患者中的有效性，比较不同远程交付模式的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Remote tele-prehabilitation offers comparable effectiveness to traditional rehabilitation for patients awaiting hip/knee arthroplasty. Consider it a viable alternative when designing pre-operative rehab programs for this patient population.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。

items.title: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence and its association with 3-month hip functional recovery among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery: a prospective observational study
items.summary: This prospective observational study found early postoperative functional exercise adherence to be associated with 3-month hip functional recovery in older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery.
items.curatedReason: 早期术后功能锻炼的依从性，在股骨颈骨折术后的老年患者中，与 3 个月时的髋关节功能恢复相关。这强调了早期教育和支持患者依从性的重要性。
items.titleZh: 早期术后功能锻炼依从性与老年股骨颈骨折术后 3 个月髋关节功能恢复的关联：一项前瞻性观察研究
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性观察研究发现，早期术后功能锻炼依从性与老年股骨颈骨折术后 3 个月髋关节功能恢复相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence is associated with 3-month hip functional recovery in older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery. This underscores the importance of early patient education and support for adherence.
items.limitation: 该观察性研究无法确定因果关系，且依从性可能受到多种未测量因素影响。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality, and adherence may be influenced by various unmeasured factors.

items.title: Parkinsonian gait improvement through vibratory stride parameter feedback
items.summary: A study protocol suggests that vibratory stride parameter feedback can improve parkinsonian gait.
items.curatedReason: 帕金森病患者的步态可以通过振动步幅参数反馈得到改善。在处理帕金森病患者的步态障碍时，可以考虑将这类生物反馈技术作为辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 振动步幅参数反馈改善帕金森病步态
items.summaryZh: 一项研究协议表明，振动步幅参数反馈可以改善帕金森病患者的步态。
items.curatedReasonEn: Parkinsonian gait can be improved through vibratory stride parameter feedback. Consider such biofeedback techniques as an adjunct in managing gait disturbances in your Parkinson's disease patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。

items.title: Lower-limb rate of torque development, but not peak torque, is associated with balance performance in older adults with and without Parkinson’s disease: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: This cross-sectional study found that lower-limb rate of torque development, but not peak torque, is associated with balance performance in older adults with and without Parkinson’s disease.
items.curatedReason: 下肢扭矩发展速率而非峰值扭矩与帕金森病患者及老年人的平衡表现相关。在评估帕金森病及老年患者的跌倒风险和设计平衡训练时，应更侧重于扭矩发展速率而非单纯的肌力峰值。
items.titleZh: 下肢扭矩发展速率而非峰值扭矩与帕金森病患者及老年人的平衡表现相关：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究发现，下肢扭矩发展速率而非峰值扭矩与帕金森病患者及老年人的平衡表现相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower-limb rate of torque development, not peak torque, is associated with balance performance in older adults with and without Parkinson's disease. When assessing fall risk and designing balance training for Parkinson's and older adult patients, prioritize rate of torque development over peak strength alone.
items.limitation: 作为一项横断面研究，无法确定因果关系，且可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality and may be subject to unmeasured confounders.
